title: Camplora 4 x 500 g Gas Cartridges with Screw Valve — Propane-Butane Gas
short_description: Camplora gas cartridges, 4-pack with 500 g propane-butane gas each and a screw valve — for camping and outdoor stoves.
long_description: According to Amazon, the Camplora set contains 4 gas cartridges with 500 g of propane-butane gas each and a screw valve (part number 7000-014-004-001). The package measures 25 x 25 x 15 cm and weighs 2.93 kg according to Amazon. Please check on the Amazon product page before buying whether the screw valve fits your stove or device. Also note the safety information on the Amazon page and on the cartridges. Gas cartridges are flammable and must be stored and transported safely.
buying_angle: Handy for campers who need a supply of gas cartridges for a camping stove with a matching screw connection.
